en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a steep hillside with a funicular railway climbing up to a fortified hilltop complex. The scene shows the wooded Schlossberg hill with stone fortification walls, buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a prominent round tower on the right. The funicular cars ascend between rocky cliffs and greenery. Printed German text appears along the top edge.
